prompt: What actually changed in ISA2027 versus ISA 6?
assertions: Describes the release model: year-based naming with an annual cycle (summer publication, effective January 1 following; ISA2028 expected summer 2027)
IS module: 46 controls retained, with analyses counting ~44 edited and substantive requirement changes in ~25 (counts attributed to analyses, not ENX)

Prototype module: restructured from five control groups to TWO domains — Organizational Requirements and Physical & Environmental Security — at 20 controls, with new traceability/lifecycle and disposal/return controls
New PTS label structure: Prototype Protection Basic (AL2) and Prototype Protection Facilities (AL3), Facilities encompassing Basic

Mentions supply-chain strengthening (high: documented supplier monitoring; very high: TISAX label, equivalent assessment or supplier audit) and updated mappings (NIST CSF 2.0, refined ISO 27001:2022, 2013 references removed)
